q-0375.answer:
Surah Maryam (19) — Mary · 98 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The people who have deviated away from the truth and are inclined towards falsehood.
• Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.
• [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
• When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
• So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0577.answer:
Surah Al-Ma'aarij (70) — The Ascending Stairways · 44 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The believers believe that its occurrence is near, even though its time of occurrence is unknown and no one knows when it will be except Allah.
• Man is described with blameworthy characteristics except for He whom Allah protects, helps and guides to good, making its means easy for him – and these are those people who perform Salah.
• What is wrong with these disbelievers who are with you, O Muhammad? Why are they Muhti'in, meaning hastily running away from you?' This is as Al-Hasan Al-Basri said, "Muhti'in means departing.
• Be patient, O Muhammad, with your people's rejection and their seeking to hasten the torment since they think it will not occur.
• Whenever any harm touches him he is frightful, worried and completely taken back due to the severity of his terror and his despair that he will receive any good after it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Surah Az-Zalzala (99) — The Earthquake · 8 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• So that they may act and be rewarded for what they did in this life of good and evil.
• He will be baffled by its situation after it used to be stable, settled and firm, and he used to be settled upon its surface.
• They will return from the station of the Judgement in separate groups.

q-0726.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah An-Naas (114) — Mankind · 6 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
• The Sovereign of mankind.
• The God of mankind,
• From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

c-0001.answer:
Oppression means being denied choice — and that is precisely what the Quran does not do. The command of modest dress (Quran 24:31, 33:59) is addressed to the believing woman herself, as an act of worship between her and Allah, just as the same passage first commands men to lower their gaze (24:30). A woman forced to cover against her will and a woman forced to uncover against her will suffer the same injustice: someone else controlling her body. Islam condemns both — "There is no compulsion in religion" (2:256).

Millions of educated women — surgeons, scientists, athletes, judges — wear hijab by conviction and describe it as liberation from being valued for appearance. Khadijah (r.a.) ran one of Makkah's major businesses; Aisha (r.a.) taught the greatest male scholars of her generation. The measure of dignity in Islam is taqwa, not visibility: "The most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you" (49:13).
